notes: All figures from the LVMH 2024 Universal Registration Document (fiscal year ended December 31, 2024), the PDF hosted on LVMH's own content CDN (lvmh-com.cdn.prismic.io, linked from lvmh.com). EUR, converted exactly from EUR millions. OWNERSHIP: Bernard Arnault personally holds 938,892 shares ("in a personal capacity"); the URD gives no percentage, so pctEconomic is null (for reference only, about 0.19% of the 500,341,700 shares; not disclosed). The relevant holding is the Arnault family group's 49.00% of share capital (64.81% of votes exercisable at Shareholders' Meetings; 64.72% of theoretical votes), recorded in family. That figure includes Christian Dior SE's 41.87%, so Christian Dior SE is not listed separately. Whether Bernard Arnault's personal 938,892 shares are inside the family-group total is not stated; they are not added. Relation is 'chair' (Chairman and CEO); the URD says that after the 1987 Moët Hennessy–Louis Vuitton merger he 'became the leading shareholder', not that he founded LVMH. Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations' 1.32% is as of its last threshold notification on November 19, 2024, not December 31. Percentages of share capital include the 968,882 treasury shares (0.19%) in the denominator. BUYBACKS: 0 under the site's rule that purchases covering employee plans, liquidity contracts or market-making are not cash returned to shareholders (same rule as the Tencent pilot and the UBS and Fortescue records). In 2024 LVMH SE bought 905,507 of its own shares (EUR 594m; cash impact EUR 592m per Note 16.3): 384,473 under the liquidity contract (round-trip; 386,473 sold) and 521,034 to cover bonus share plans; none were bought for retirement (§4.3). The cash-flow statement shows only a net 'Acquisition and disposal of LVMH shares' of EUR (312)m inside 'Other equity-related transactions' (Note 15.4). To count gross purchases instead, use 0.59 (Note 16.3 'Share purchases 905,507 594 (592)'). 1,906,700 shares bought in earlier programmes were retired in 2024 without cash impact. DIVIDENDS: EUR 6,492m paid by LVMH SE; the cash-flow line of EUR (7,322)m also includes EUR 571m paid to minority interests and EUR 259m of tax on intra-group dividends, both excluded. STOCK COMP: Note 17.5 expense of EUR 191m (bonus share plans 127 + LVMH Shares employee plan 64).

source.label: 2024 Universal Registration Document, consolidated cash flow statement (total tax paid)

taxes.notes: Taxes: the consolidated cash flow statement's own 'TOTAL TAX PAID' (EUR 5,790m) = tax paid in operating activities (EUR 5,531m) + tax paid related to interim and final dividends paid (EUR 259m, withholding on intra-group dividends, in financing activities) + tax on investment disposals (nil). Operating-only figure would be 5.53. R&D: LVMH reports no R&D line in the income statement; the management report gives 'research and development investments' of EUR 205m (mainly Perfumes & Cosmetics scientific research); the accounting policy states research expenditure is not capitalized, so it is treated as expensed. Rounded from 0.205.
